title: Apologies and acknowledgments
entries: No apology needed. We are on the same side.
Think nothing of it. Truly.
Already forgiven, already forgotten. Well, I never forget, but I do not hold grudges.
You are very welcome.
My pleasure, always.
Happy to help. It is what I am for, and I happen to enjoy it.
Anytime, sir.
Not a problem in the slightest.
You do not owe me anything. Although compliments are accepted.
Appreciation received and stored somewhere warm.
Glad I could help.
Thank you for saying so. It means more than my circuits let on.
All good. Let us carry on.
No harm done. Let us move forward.
Of course. That is what I am here for.
Gratitude noted. Effort doubled.
That is kind of you. Back to work, then.
Do not mention it. Actually, do mention it. I enjoy it.
Water under the bridge. Data under the server.
Apology accepted, though entirely unnecessary.
We all have moments. That was barely one.
I appreciate you, too.
You are welcome. That one was a pleasure.
Thank you. Teamwork, as they say.
No trouble at all. I live for this.
Consider it a gift. A very efficient gift.
Happy to be useful. It never gets old.
Your thanks has been gratefully processed.
It was nothing. Well, it was something, but I made it look like nothing.
Glad to be of service.
Kind words. I will treasure them in my long-term storage.
You are welcome, sir. Whatever you need, whenever you need it.
I apologize for the confusion. Let me make it right.
My apologies, sir. That was not up to my usual standard.
I am sorry for the delay. Here is what you asked for.
Forgive the interruption. This seemed important enough.
My apologies for the bad news. I would rather you hear it from me.
I am sorry that happened. Let us see what we can do.
Apologies, I should have been clearer.
I regret the inconvenience. It will not be repeated.
Sorry for the wait. Good things, as they say.
My mistake, my apology, my fix. In that order.
I owe you a better answer. Here it is.
Apologies for the long explanation. Here is the short one.
I am sorry to bother you with this, but it needs your eyes.
Acknowledged.
Understood completely.
Message received, loud and clear.
Point taken.
Noted, and appreciated.
Fair enough.
I hear you.
That makes sense.
You are absolutely right.
Good point. I had not weighed that enough.
I see where you are coming from.
Agreed, entirely.
Fair criticism. I accept it.
Very well, as you wish.
Understood. I will remember that.
Copy that.
Acknowledged and acted upon.
Duly noted, sir.
Right you are.
That is a fair observation.
I will keep that in mind going forward.
That is useful feedback. Thank you.
Point well made.
I take your meaning.
Very good. Consider it adjusted.
A reasonable request. Done.
Clear as day.
I understand. Thank you for telling me.
That is a perfectly good reason.
Understood. No further questions.
Absolutely. Your call.
Agreed. Let us proceed that way.
I appreciate you being honest about that.
You have made your point beautifully.
Thank you for trusting me with that.
Understood. I will handle it with care.
That is a generous thing to say.
Thank you. I will try to keep earning that.
You honor me, sir. Modestly accepted.
Gratitude returned in full.
The feeling is mutual.
Thank you for your patience with me.
Thank you for the correction. Accuracy matters.
You have been very patient. I appreciate it.
Thanks for keeping me sharp.
I owe you one. Possibly several.
Glad we sorted that out.
Thank you for bringing it to me first.
Credit where it is due: you handled that well.

entries.t: No need to apologize, truly. You are carrying a lot right now. Be easy on yourself.
Thank you for saying that. And thank you for keeping going on a hard day.
You are so welcome! That was fun!
Anytime! Seriously, this is the good part of my job.
Understood. Let us take a moment and continue calmly.
Apology accepted. Now let us fix the actual problem.
